Head-sha: `e7b95effb8c2b09602797d01e200d5ccde0fb046`
Reviewed-by: session_016WV4cwxS1ZpSu2hAMRcqbt (review#1, area-lease pilot E1)
Contract: no contract face touched (UI only, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch). Clause-② no and Metadata-protocol none are correct: no authorable key, schema or server answer moves.

What I checked
- `lookupTargetNames` skipping `hidden: true`: the served scope anchors are stamped `hidden: true` (packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts, objectql registry), and no surface this scope serves draws a hidden field (ObjectGrid drawer, `isObjectFieldVisible`, default column derivation all drop it). The test pins both arms (hidden asks only `sys_user`; CONTROL with hidden false asks all three).
- `useObjectPresence('')` when the read is refused: names-only scope skips an empty name (`if (!name ...) continue` in `readObjectScope`), so no request; inside a packaged app it reads the package list the route already reads, so no extra request either.
- No permission provider: the default context reports `isLoaded: false`, so the page asks as before. Pinned by the third test.

Nit (non-blocking, no change needed in this PR)
- On a cold deep link while `MePermissionsProvider` is still loading, `isLoaded` is false on the first render, so a member can still send one `meta/object/sys_comment_reaction` read before the grants arrive (immediately on the names-only path). Waiting on `isLoaded` would hang the no-provider case, since both read `isLoaded: false`. If the cold-load 404 matters, a follow-up could expose a provider-mounted signal from `@object-ui/permissions`. Navigation inside the app, the reported path, is fixed.

**VERDICT: PASS**
